theme: Professional, tidy, high-trust CRM dashboard for Tour, Travel & Umrah.

colors.background: bg-slate-50 for application background to ensure white surfaces pop.
colors.surface: bg-white for sidebars, cards, and dialogs.
colors.border: border-slate-200 for soft but clear separation.

typography.headings: Keep existing font-display. Ensure tight tracking for large sizes (tracking-tight).

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Tight and scanned optimized.
spacing_and_layout.card_padding: p-5 or p-6 to provide breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.optical_alignment: Left-align text/labels; right-align numbers/metrics in tables.

components.buttons: Rounded-md (max 6px radius). Primary: bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-700. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.cards: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm (avoid heavy shadows).
components.tables: Remove outer borders if inside a card to avoid double borders. Header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200. Rows: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50.
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Use soft background + dark text.
components.dialogs: Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-900/30). Dialog box bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200.
components.sidebar: Clean separation with border-r border-slate-200. Active item: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-medium. Inactive: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.topbar: Must have solid or semi-solid background. bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md z-40 border-b border-slate-200.

motion.interactions: Buttons: active:scale-[0.98] transition-all. Table rows: hover transition-colors duration-150.

testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Example: data-testid='submit-quotation-btn'

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Add padding where visual weight requires it.
Information hierarchy: Use font weights (semibold vs regular) and color (slate-900 vs slate-500) to separate data from labels.
Frictionless interactions: Clearly define hover and active states for all clickable elements.
Negative Space: Value empty areas, do not stretch tables/cards just to fill space unnecessarily.
instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: Check tailwind.config.js and globals.css/index.css to ensure base styling aligns with slate + blue palette.
Step 2: Refactor DashboardLayout (.js) to implement the crisp sidebar and topbar rules.
Step 3: Polish Shadcn UI components (.js files in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/) - particularly Card, Button, Table, Badge, Dialog.
Step 4: Refactor Customer 360, Quotations, and Dashboard views to use the new consistent spacing (gap-6, p-6) and subtle borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Keep existing colors (Blue/Slate) as requested by user. Do not change functionality.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so use standard JSX and JS conventions.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use structured left-aligned or grid-based flows.
Create depth using layered z-index hierarchy (shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for dropdowns/dialogs).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
